limits: Standard limits only: work on this dated branch, never push to master.
Never create .agentweave/, agentweave.yml or spec/ at the repository root. Test projects live outside the repo.
Stage paths explicitly. Never suppress stderr on staging commands - a swallowed error is how 1f79918 shipped an empty commit under a message describing three fixes.
Never mark a task complete on the strength of a plan existing. Only real, verified implementation closes a task.
Every tasks.md splits agent-verifiable from human-only and emits a user test guide.
The ci.yml question is settled - 'just push the branch'. Do not raise it again.
The requeue rule is 'any failed run, capped at 3'. Do not re-propose the narrow variant.
G5, the interview backstop, is a non-goal.
Evidence can be anything the model thinks shows its work is good. Only test agents can accept evidence; with no tester agent it all defers to the operator.
Derive constants, do not tune them to one monitor.
Use openspec, never the aw-spec skills, and never run AgentWeave against this repo.
Do not call the Agent tool, and do not use workflows or deep research, unless the user requests it. The user HAS requested deep web research, for q7 only.
Refresh last_heartbeat at every commit - see heartbeat_contract.

dead_ends: git add on a path that was deleted and already unstaged aborts the whole add and stages nothing.
npx openspec status --change rejects names starting with a digit; npx openspec archive accepts them. Do not conclude archiving is blocked.
openspec archive prefixes the archive date, producing 2026-08-15-2026-08-13-... in a repo that already dates change names. Rename after archiving.

Keep .ps1 files ASCII-only. PS 5.1 reads BOM-less UTF-8 as ANSI and an em dash inside a quoted string breaks parsing several tokens away. Syntax-check with Parser::ParseFile, from the repo root - from hub/ the relative paths resolve to nothing and it reports a spurious FAIL.
PowerShell 5.1 Add-Content -Encoding utf8 writes a BOM. Use UTF8Encoding($false).
Editing a file with Python newline='\n' when git has it as CRLF shows as modified with an empty --numstat. git checkout -- it; it is whitespace-only.
Register-ScheduledTask reports LastTaskResult 267011 before a task has ever run - a stale slot, not an error. 267009 means currently running.
Event rows are in event_logs, payload column data.
